requirements.quote:
The next two messages from the server, EncryptedExtensions and
   CertificateRequest, contain information from the server that
   determines the rest of the handshake.
requirements.condition: when the server sends CertificateRequest in its post-ServerHello flight
requirements.why_checkable: The two server handshake message types have an explicit relative order.

requirements.quote:
These messages are encrypted
   with keys derived from the server_handshake_traffic_secret.
requirements.required_behavior: encrypt it with keys derived from server_handshake_traffic_secret
requirements.why_checkable: The record protection epoch for EncryptedExtensions can be traced to its traffic secret.
